verdict.rationale: The evidence documents uploading and updating persons and transactions through addPerson, CSV upload and partial-attribute updates, and shows cases linked to customers in the UI. None of it says records are keyed on stable client-supplied external identifiers, and there is no API for reconciling case records. The 'identifiers you choose' item concerns sanctions good-listing, which is a different capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
